paragraphs: Zone & Co’s ERP‑native AI platform tackles the pain of siloed financial data by embedding intelligence directly in Oracle NetSuite – a challenge I tackled by deploying an agent as a Docker container on AWS Lambda, using ECR image pipelines, IAM execution roles and least‑privilege policies.

I proposed and prototyped an MCP‑based agentic tool in Python (FastMCP, Ollama gpt‑oss:20b, PostgreSQL, GitHub Actions CI) for a Madrid‑based product start‑up client, presenting it in a live stakeholder demo.
I have not used Azure yet.
